no_adcom_quote.quote: NDA 206829 was not presented before the Anti-Infective Drugs Advisory Committee. There were no particular issues with safety, efficacy, or trial design that warranted presenting the application to an Advisory Committee.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for ZERBAXA (ceftolozane/tazobactam, NDA 206829). The Office Director memo states the application was not presented to the Anti-Infective Drugs Advisory Committee because there were no particular safety, efficacy, or trial-design issues warranting it, and the Cross-Discipline Team Leader review's Advisory Committee Meeting section is marked "Not applicable." Because no AdCom was held, there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
